text: I had double eyelid surgery with Dr. Nean and it was amazing. After the stitches were removed, no one could tell I had eyelid surgery. The wound healed very quickly; the doctor has a gentle touch. He also removed a birthmark on my daughter's eyelid. He's incredibly skilled! Now I'm waiting for my daughter to have her stitches removed on the 20th. After that, I'll do a full review on my TikTok and Facebook channels.
